summary: Closure review of revised manuscript for CNSM Agentic-AI track. The authors addressed the prior reference-formatting requirement by providing verified bibliographic metadata and numeric in-text citations. However, the mandatory Disclosure Statement still contains run-level file paths and full hashes and therefore remains non-compliant with the track's concise-disclosure requirement. All other previously requested edits are either implemented or optional. Accept-for-finalisation is false until the Disclosure Statement is condensed as required.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement remains verbose and includes run-internal file paths and full hashes (e.g., execution/raw_results.jsonl, provenance/master_prompt.txt SHA‑256). Per track rules the Disclosure must be a concise paragraph reporting the mandatory items but must not duplicate execution logs or include file-level paths and full hashes in ordinary manuscript prose.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement into a concise paragraph that reports the mandatory items only: LLM(s) used and model identifiers, orchestration/adapter framework, immutable master-prompt reference (identify by artifact name and a single manifest hash or DOI-like pointer if necessary), autonomy-lock boundary, preregistration existence (study id), that artifacts/manifests are archived and where (archive name or manifest file), and that no human edited the manuscript post-lock. Remove file-level paths, per-episode filenames, and full SHA‑256 hashes from the Disclosure text; point readers to the archived execution manifest (named and optionally referenced by one manifest-level checksum) for low-level provenance and audit details.

Confirm that the manuscript References section is a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography using the provided verified terminal_bibliographic_records metadata (authors, title, venue/year, DOI/URL as supplemental) and ensure each in-text numeric citation points to the matching IEEE-formatted entry that supports the proximate claim. If this is already done, include a brief note in the Disclosure that the references were verified against archived metadata.
optional_revisions: Explicitly state in Methods one short sentence that execution/model_configuration.json records temperature = null and that null indicates provider-default sampling semantics and should not be interpreted as evidence of deterministic (temperature=0) sampling (if not already phrased identically).

If space permits, add one short paragraph in Discussion contrasting how an independent-generation arm or a repair-enabled arm would change the estimand and enable non-degenerate inference; cite the preregistered sensitivity scripts/artifacts that implement those alternatives.
